subject.title: fix(msteams): emit native cjs runtime entrypoints

question: Should `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` become the supported package metadata contract for official plugins that require native CJS runtime entrypoints?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but adding a permanent package-build mode and metadata key is a compatibility-sensitive contract choice that repository history and tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt opt-in CJS
options.body: Accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` as the supported package-build seam after installed-package execution proof and an exact-main refresh.

options.title: Keep builds ESM-only
options.body: Decline the new metadata key and address Microsoft Teams startup cost through loader or bundling changes instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt opt-in CJS
recommendation.body: Accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` as the supported package-build seam after installed-package execution proof and an exact-main refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and repeatedly maintained the package-local runtime build and manifest pipeline that owns this contract.
